name: Calenzano (Italy)
description: Blue field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Calenzano (a yellow lion on red with a light blue bend) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Calenzano, a comune in Tuscany; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Calenzano arms — yellow lion on red with a light blue bend, crowned, within branches
